dispositions: Missing scale identifiers remain scale-definition; no identifier is inferred from a translated title.
Both number/faces and historical n/die dice definitions retain typed dice, not numeric bonuses.
Scholar expertise object alternatives share a mutually exclusive set; source parent/child grants stay cumulative.
The omitted choose.count default is one; no choice answer is generated.
Temporal Awareness maps its literal init.total effect to initiative.
Item transfer effects retain deferred wrappers and require equipping/attunement binding before passive application.
Empty uses.max does not become a finite counter.
Day recovery without an explicit dawn/rest trigger remains pending; numeric short/long rules retain exact amounts.
Opaque activation conditions, external consumers, negative replenishment consumers and conditional target effects stay deferred.
The Charm Animals and Plants damage payload is accepted only as deferred sidecar data; no claim that the sidecar agrees with narrative rules.
